topic: ML API instance management and testing
summary_markdown:
Discussion focused on optimizing the deployment of multiple instances for an ML API. It was suggested that instead of simply running several copies, it would be better to increase vcpu and configure the appropriate number of workers within uvicorn. The conversation noted that Python is single-threaded and that while uv cannot manage new app instances dynamically, it can launch several immediately.

Later, a participant mentioned an issue with broken conditions related to partial day absences.
action_items: Review ML API deployment configuration (vcpu/uvicorn workers)
